title: Reminders & Notifications
description: Enable notifications to receive activity reminders with your children and important updates.
activeDescription: You are receiving activity reminders on this device.
deniedDescription: Notifications are blocked in your browser. To receive reminders, allow them in your site settings.
inactiveDescription: Your browser allows notifications, but this device isn't registered to receive them yet. On iPhone, add the app to your Home Screen before enabling.
